title: Leave no descriptors behind
summary: Two hundred pipes in a loop: close every end, and the next free descriptor is still 3.
hints: Both ends of every pipe must be closed in the parent: the write end right after the `fork` (or the reader never sees the end of the data) and the read end when you are done.
The child closes the two original ends after `dup2`, before the `exec`.
`dup(0)` returns the LOWEST free descriptor. With only 0, 1 and 2 open it returns `3`; if you leaked descriptors it returns a bigger number.
